title: Three-second-grid counterfactual harmonic scheduling of measured minute profiles

input.primary_measurement_source: Hartmann et al., Nature Energy (2026), DOI 10.1038/s41560-026-02144-0, Source Data Fig. 6, extracted to CSV by the root workflow.
input.measured_units: Three building-level meters; sixteen weekly mean profiles per meter; twenty samples per minute.

conventions.real_waveform: p(t)=c_0+2 Re sum_{k>=1} c_k exp(i k omega t), except that the discrete Nyquist coefficient is unpaired.
conventions.random_comparator: The square root of expected squared RMS is distinguished from the expectation of RMS. Both are computed exactly for the three-meter case.
conventions.admissible_offsets: 0,3,...,57 seconds only; first-meter offset is fixed to zero in exhaustive search by global phase invariance.
conventions.counterfactual_boundary: Only circular shifts of the observed twenty-sample profiles are evaluated. Actual firmware access, inter-test deadlines, state-dependent waveform changes, clock/calibration errors, and between-sample extrema are not validated.

three_measured_locations.interpretation: Counterfactual shifts of the three measured building profiles, separately within each measured week.
three_measured_locations.global_phase_fix_is_exact: Every common integer-slot shift rotates each harmonic but leaves the objective invariant.

frozen_first_week_schedule_holdout.status: Out-of-week template-shift evaluation without retuning; not a physical intervention and not an independent-fleet experiment.
frozen_first_week_schedule_holdout.interpretation: A calibrated fixed schedule is not shown to remain beneficial as the measured building signatures change. The worst-case stationarity/error bill cannot be omitted.

fabricated_200_template_replica_fleet.status: FABRICATED COUNTERFACTUAL POPULATION; NOT AN OBSERVED FLEET
fabricated_200_template_replica_fleet.construction: Balanced replication of all 48 measured building/week templates to N=200, followed by a fixed-seed permutation. Different weeks of the same meter are reused as if independent controllable devices solely for a numerical construction check.
claims_excluded: No claim that 200 such devices were measured simultaneously.
No claim that a building-level profile can actually be shifted by firmware.
No claim that the 48 templates are independent experimental units.
No subsecond interpolation or inferred subsecond waveform structure.
No physical clock/calibration uncertainty is included in this ideal template replay.

algorithm_certificate.algorithm: Nullspace support elimination then deterministic conditional-expectation rounding
algorithm_certificate.real_arithmetic_operation_bound: O((N M)^2 + N M (2K)^3) for this implementation, including repeated full support scans. Maintaining an active support list reduces the scans and recovers O(N M (2K)^3) arithmetic. Neither is an exact bit-complexity claim.
